definitions.gloss: playing a match, game (in board games)
definitions.explanation: A formal match or game between two players in board games such as Go, shogi, or chess. Emphasizes the competitive, face-to-face nature of the match.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な{対局|たいきょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have an important match today.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{棋士|きし}→棋士：27809_kishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対局|たいきょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The two professional players began their shogi match.

examples.japanese: ⟦タイトル→タイトル：03855_taitoru⟧⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{対局|たいきょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生中継|なまちゅうけい}→生中継：16355_namachuukei⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見守|みまも}った→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧。
examples.english: The title match was broadcast live on the internet, so many fans watched.

notes:
USAGE:
Used specifically for board games like ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧, ⟦{囲碁|いご}→囲碁：18035_igo⟧ (Go), and ⟦チェス→チェス：11040_chesu⟧. Not used for sports matches (⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧) or card games. Carries a formal, serious tone associated with professional competition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対局|たいきょく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to play a match)
- {対局|たいきょく}⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧ (opponent in a match)
- {対局|たいきょく}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (during a match)
- {対局|たいきょく}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (match room)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧: match, game — for sports and general competition
- ⟦{勝負|しょうぶ}→勝負：01437_shoubu⟧: contest, showdown — emphasizes the win/lose outcome
